fusions.name: Wingbeat Barbs
fusions.desc: Looses 3 stingers at once, spread apart; each deals 2 damage and has a 25% chance to leave the target [Poisoned] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Beeline
fusions.desc: You fly up to 8 tiles to the target and sting it. The sting deals 11 damage and leaves it [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Foragers Loosed
fusions.desc: Sends out a swarm for 10 seconds that stings an enemy within 5 tiles for 2 damage every half second.

fusions.name: Sixth Sting
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 6. At 6 they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 27% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
